summary: Under the mixed (Both) restoration-and-conservation commitment, Vietnam aims to increase forest cover to 42% by 2030 and maintain a stable level through 2050 by increasing planted-forest area and protecting natural forests; the passage also reports an 11.1 MtCO2eq reduction in 2020. A second Both passage gives a 3.5% LULUCF figure, but the supplied excerpt does not identify the indicator or timeframe. Under Agriculture, a 30% target is paired with integrated crop management and related measures, including wet–dry irrigation, SRI, composting and organic agriculture, fertilizer changes, and agricultural-waste recycling. Agriculture covers 151,924 km² (46.4% of the country), while current forest cover is 38.2%. The forest goal implies a 3.8-percentage-point increase; the denominators for the 30% and 3.5% figures are not stated.
